heroIntro: Data Analyst & AI Engineer at **ESB Power Line**. I turn data into products: from Bangladesh's power-sector news & data portal to machine-learning apps and medical-imaging research.
about: I'm a **Data Analyst & AI Engineer at ESB Power Line** and a Computer Science & Engineering graduate of BRAC University. I build AI and data products end to end — models, APIs and the web apps people actually use — and I'm passionate about AI-driven healthcare, NLP and turning messy real-world data into decisions.
